name: BAS Box Handling Experiment
disclaimer: HEURISTIC-LIVE DEMO DEFINITION (drop-in; canonical default lives in experiment/experiment.json). expectedObjects use ONLY the three classes the local heuristic detector genuinely reports (person, red_box, yellow_box). experiment_box/target_area are honestly NOT detectable without a trained model, so OPEN_BOX fires once the opened box exposes the red box and PLACE steps fire when the box is visible. This variant exists so the camera-grounded live path can complete every step on real frames; the canonical definition stays authoritative.
description: Live, camera-grounded demo of the BAS box-handling sequence. Advance is driven by actual heuristic detections on camera: a person (approach), the red box becoming visible (open/pick/place), the yellow box becoming visible (pick/place), and both boxes in view (complete).

steps.label: Astronaut approaches the experiment area
steps.description: The astronaut enters the experiment area and is detected near the setup.

steps.label: Astronaut opens the main experiment box
steps.description: Opened enough that the red box inside becomes visible to the heuristic detector.

steps.label: Astronaut picks up the red box
steps.description: The red box is visible out of the main experiment box.

steps.label: Astronaut places the red box into the designated target area
steps.description: The red box is visible inside the target area (heuristic cannot distinguish placement).

steps.label: Astronaut picks up the yellow box
steps.description: The yellow box is visible out of the main experiment box.

steps.label: Astronaut places the yellow box into the designated target area
steps.description: The yellow box is visible inside the target area (heuristic cannot distinguish placement).

steps.label: Both boxes are correctly placed and the experiment is complete
steps.description: Both the red and yellow box are visible and the experiment finishes.

validationRules.nextExpectedOnError: unchanged - the offending step must be performed again to advance
validationRules.skippedStepEvidence: SKIPPED_STEP is advisory and is only emitted together with OUT_OF_SEQUENCE; progress advances exclusively on STEP_MATCHED

errorTypes.when: detected activity equals the expected step
known activity from a later step is detected before the expected step
advisory emitted together with OUT_OF_SEQUENCE (a later step implies earlier steps were skipped)
known activity from an already-completed step is detected again
detected activity is null or not defined in this experiment
detected activity confidence is below the validationRules.lowConfidenceThreshold
errorTypes.progressEffect: none - treat the detection as uncertain

example.note: The expected step does not change when a later step fires out of order; the operator (or voice cue) re-prompts for the expected step.
